scope: Post-hoc model-form sensitivity on the same Setx source libraries; no independent biological replication or primary-family extension.
input: Original gene-level RSEM expected_count, effective_length and TPM; do not round estimated counts.
implementation: edgeR 4.10.6 DGEListFromTximport with countsFromAbundance=no and existing gene-level effective lengths; no transcript re-quantification or tximport package installation.
filter: Preliminary edgeR filterByExpr with ten categorical cell means, then require positive finite effective lengths in every retained library; record exclusions, do not impute zero lengths.
fit: Native DGEListFromTximport length-offset prior, filterByExpr, normLibSizes(TMM), glmQLFit(robust=TRUE, legacy=FALSE), four-column interaction contrast from the prior frozen model.
multiplicity: BY over every expressed original gene ID for the joint four-df quasi-likelihood F test, separately per variant; BH sensitivity.
effect_comparison: Map fixed 105/36 symbols uniquely after testing; P18-P10 genotype-contrast signs and magnitudes compared descriptively to prior TPM model. No new subset FDR.
uncertainties: No inferential replicates or quantification-uncertainty correction available.
Source animal/pooling and barcode/technical limitations persist.
Count and TPM filter universes and effect estimands differ; compare matched genes explicitly.
No count-based single-library omission suite in this sensitivity; no inherited all-omission stability claim.
